File surface: new `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/comments/*` (`useRecordComments`, `CommentItem`, `CommentThread`, `CommentComposer`, `CommentFilterMenu`, `CommentsButton`, desktop `CommentsPanel` and `CommentHoverActions`) and the plugin-detail entry exports; `RecordActivityTimeline.tsx`, `renderers/record-activity.tsx`, `recordTimelineStream.ts`; app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx`; components `record-top-bar.tsx`, `navigation-overlay.tsx` (an optional slot each); react `DiscussionContext.tsx`; new i18n keys in every locale; tests, changesets. No governed surface, no `packages/spec`.
Container & model: `L`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening) (new plugin-detail exports; optional fields on `RecordTopBar`, `NavigationOverlay` and `DiscussionContextValue`; nothing removed or renamed; the seat runs the declaration-face L2)
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, read on main `493ad095`, file `build-seat1/36075/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds. The comment data lives in `RecordDetailView` behind `DiscussionContextProvider`, and the drawer embeds the same view, so page and drawer already share data.
Basis: card #36075 (mock-ups approved by the maintainer); epic #36062.
Scope, the seat's reading: the card's nine items. Panel 380 wide; at a window of 1280 or more the content gives way, below it the panel overlays; in the drawer, a split at 760 or more and an overlay of the drawer body below that; open state kept per page and per drawer. The header icon sits in the record row before Edit, through one optional slot each in `RecordTopBar` and `NavigationOverlay`; objects with feeds off show none. The Activity tab drops comments on desktop page and drawer only (phones keep them until #36076). The count is top-level comments until #36071 merges. One open question goes to the maintainer separately: what happens on the six pages whose authors placed their own activity or discussion block.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial behind #36070 (same files; merge main after it lands and reuse its avatar, reply focus and delete toast) and #36071 (resolved UI wired after it merges, or a second PR if it is slow). `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #36075`.

The panel still gives way at windows of 1280 and up. Record: see #35890.

repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Seat note · 2026-11-21T16:43Z · #36075, who decided where the comment panel appears (PR #36114). This answers the declaration L2's E2.

- **The choice:** the panel and its header icon appear only on record pages drawn from the default stream, including those whose overrides only fill slots. The hand-written pages (showcase `project-detail`, `sys-queue`, `sys-audit-log`) keep the discussion block in the footer, where their authors placed it.
- **Who decided:** the seat's Fable decision review at 2026-11-21T13:24Z (`build-seat1/36075/fable-handwritten-pages.md`). It found that the choice needs no maintainer card, because it follows a standing maintainer ruling recorded in code: decision batch #120, item 5, 2026-09-12, at `RecordDetailView.tsx:5150`. That ruling says a page is what its author composed, and nothing is appended by default and then switched off. The claim's open question was therefore settled under that ruling, without a new card.
- **Follow-up:** letting a hand-written page opt in to the panel is phase 2. The seat files that card when phase 1 is done.

Area: b1-CM

Account: `os-sales`
Branch: claude/project-thread-5vdwwn (from fresh main after #36114 merges; not stacked)
File surface: plugin-detail `comments/*` (`CommentsPanel`, `useRecordComments`, `CommentHoverActions` resolve wiring), `DiscussionContext` (resolve write; whether the reader may manage others' comments), the feed item type, a three-state record-editable read, app-shell `RecordDetailView.tsx` comment mapping and write handlers only; i18n keys in every locale; tests, docs, README, changeset.
Container & model: `M`, card thread, `model: opus`, `effort: high`
Clause-②: yes (widening): new `DiscussionContext` members, new feed item fields, a new exported hook, new i18n keys.
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise (thread, file `build-seat1/36075/pr2/premise-read.md` in the project folder): holds. #36104's `is_resolved`, `resolved_by` and `resolved_at` already arrive on both comment reads, so no server change. The check mark and filters appear only where the row carries `is_resolved`. The resolver's name is resolved on the client from names the page already has.
Scope, the seat's reading:
- Resolve and unresolve for whoever can read the record (ruling 7063285032); the resolved look; the icon count becomes unresolved threads.
- The filter follows the card's item 7 wording: two checkboxes, "show resolved" and "only threads I'm in" (computed on the client by `threadsInvolvingUser`'s rule), not remembered in the browser.
- Card item 6: edit and delete on others' comments are offered only when the server's own rule answers yes (the parent record's by-id update explain), read three-state so an error never grants them. No server permission changes, so no maintainer question.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: overlap on `RecordDetailView.tsx` with #36112, #36150 (PR #36174), #36147, #36151, in a different region (comment mapping and writes). `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. Declaration L2 at `TIER_DEFAULT` on the green head; L1 at L1-c. The PR carries `Fixes #36075`.
